problems.issue: Relying solely on a Facebook page instead of a dedicated, custom business website.
problems.impact: Limits brand credibility, professional appearance, and search engine optimization (SEO) potential for high-value dental services.

problems.issue: Lack of structured online booking or appointment scheduling integration on the profile.
problems.impact: Friction for prospective patients wanting to schedule visits outside of clinic hours, potentially leading to lost leads.

problems.issue: Absence of clear, easily accessible information regarding dental services, pricing, and operating hours in the primary meta tags.
problems.impact: Reduces conversion rates as users must hunt for basic practice details.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-responsive website featuring an integrated online appointment booking system and patient intake forms.
Implement local SEO strategies (Google Business Profile) combined with the new website to capture high-intent local searches for dental services in Malate.
Showcase before-and-after treatment galleries, patient testimonials, and detailed service pages to build stronger trust and authority.
audit.summary: M.B.TAN Dental Clinic currently relies on a social media presence, which restricts its digital footprint, brand authority, and appointment conversion efficiency. Building a dedicated website with integrated booking and local SEO will capture high-intent patients and streamline practice growth.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on M.B.TAN Dental Clinic's online booking
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking at M.B.TAN Dental Clinic's Facebook page and noticed how active your community is. However, relying solely on social media can make it tough for patients to book appointments outside of clinic hours or quickly check your services.

Without a dedicated website, you might be missing out on folks searching Google for local dental care.

We put together a quick live demo showing what a custom site with built-in booking could look like for your practice. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---
